text: The Pakistan Hydromet and Climate Services Project (PHCSP) was a World Bank-financed initiative aimed at modernizing hydrometeorological services and strengthening disaster risk management in Pakistan. Initially focused on upgrading weather observation and forecasting systems, the project underwent significant restructuring to emphasize nature-based solutions and emergency response, aligning with national climate resilience goals.
